blocks.text: Anaerobic respiration bohat se microorganisms aur aala (higher) podon ke kuch cells mein hoti hai; yeh vertebrates ke muscle cells mein bhi hoti hai. Is mein glucose poori tarah oxidise nahin hota, is liye glucose se kam tawanai milti hai: ek glucose molecule se sirf do ATP milte hain (glucose ki tawanai ka sirf taqreeban 2%). Do ATP ki tawanai 14.6 kcal ke barabar hai.
Anaerobic respiration mein pehle glycolysis hoti hai, phir NADH pyruvic acid ko reduce kar ke ya to lactic acid banata hai ya alcohol aur CO₂. Is liye is ki do qismein hain:

a- Alcoholic fermentation: qadeem prokaryotic cells (bacteria) aur kuch eukaryotic cells, jaise yeast (khameer), mein pyruvic acid alcoholic fermentation se mazeed toot kar alcohol (C₂H₅OH) aur CO₂ banata hai:
b- Lactic acid fermentation: is mein oxygen ke baghair har pyruvic acid molecule lactic acid (C₃H₆O₃) mein badal jata hai; CO₂ nahin nikalti:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein dono equations ki jagah badal gayi hai: alcoholic fermentation ke neeche lactic acid wali equation (2(C₃H₄O₃) → 2(C₃H₆O₃)) chhapi hai aur us ke product ko “Ethyl alcohol” likha hai, jabke lactic acid fermentation ke neeche alcohol aur CO₂ wali equation chhapi hai. Kitab lactic acid ka formula bhi C₂H₆O₃ likhti hai; sahi C₃H₆O₃ hai. Upar dono equations sahi jagah aur sahi shakal mein hain (4H do NADH se aate hain).

Anaerobic respiration ki yeh qisam insanon aur doosre janwaron ke muscle cells mein hoti hai, khaas taur par sakht jismani mehnat ke dauran, jab cells tak oxygen utni tezi se nahin pohanch pati jitni zaroorat hai. Bohat se bacteria bhi tawanai ke liye lactic acid fermentation karte hain.

blocks.alt: Do qataren. Upar: glucose (chhe carbon moti) Glycolysis se guzarta hai, 2 ADP + 2 Pi se 2 ATP aur 2 NAD+ se 2 NADH bante hain, aur 2 pyruvic acid bante hain; Alcoholic Fermentation mein 2 NADH + 2 H+ se 2 NAD+ bante hain aur 2 CO2 nikalti hai, aur 2 ethanol (do carbon wale) bante hain. Neeche: wohi glycolysis, phir Lactic acid Fermentation mein 2 NADH + 2 H+ se 2 NAD+ bante hain, aur 2 lactic acid (teen carbon wale) bante hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono raston mein glycolysis se sirf 2 ATP milte hain. Fermentation ka asal kaam NADH ko wapas NAD⁺ banana hai taa ke glycolysis chalta rahe. Yeast mein CO₂ nikalti hai aur ethanol banta hai; muscle mein CO₂ nahin nikalti aur lactic acid banta hai.
